public_rationale: On the ordinary reading of plan, the universal claim is contradicted. Before the post, Microsoft had specified generative AI functions within its work applications, and Amazon had launched a service for customers to build generative AI applications. These are concrete plans beyond buying GPUs. The records do not establish that the plans were wise, profitable or sufficient to achieve the companies' broader ambitions.
limitations: This verdict addresses the existence of concrete plans, not their quality or financial viability.
A narrower reading about a convincing route to profitable advanced intelligence would require different evidence.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: None of the big AI companies ever had a plan for generative AI beyond throwing GPUs at it.

statement.excerpt: I also want to be clear that none of these companies ever had a plan.

from_speaker: if they threw enough GPUs together
our_interpretation: These companies includes the major AI companies named nearby, including Microsoft and Amazon.
A plan means a concrete strategy for generative AI products, deployment or customer use beyond accumulating computing hardware.
Having a plan does not require that it succeed, become profitable or achieve artificial general intelligence.
Ever makes the target period the companies' relevant history through December 3, 2024, rather than the latest reporting quarter.
criteria.support_condition: Credible historical evidence establishes that all companies in scope lacked concrete generative AI product, deployment or commercial plans beyond hardware scaling.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one company in scope had a documented concrete generative AI plan before the post, involving identifiable products, customers or deployment methods beyond buying GPUs.

evidence.locator: Section Reinventing productivity for everyone, Word paragraph
evidence.explanation: Microsoft specified concrete generative AI functions inside Word and other work applications. That is a product and deployment strategy beyond purchasing GPUs, regardless of whether the promised benefits were achieved.
Amazon documented a deployed service for building generative AI applications, including model choice and operational controls. This is another concrete implementation beyond hardware scaling.
